:::{.justify}
The first workshop since 2019 met at UNU-MERIT in Maastricht, with Maastricht University joining the Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, Tilburg and Wageningen as co-organizers. Ten papers over two days put public services and accountability centre stage — free riding in service delivery in India, community service providers in Sierra Leone, social accountability for teachers, community-based monitoring — alongside climate-smart agriculture, seasonal migration loans, menstrual health and schooling in Bangladesh, texting parents about early child development, female admission caps in Iran and the history of pro-birth policies in Congo.

The organizing team was Eleonora Nillesen, Yannick Markhof and Karthika Sujatha, together with Erwin Bulte, Patricio S. Dalton, Wendy Janssens, Menno Pradhan and Maarten Voors. The workshop was co-sponsored by the Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam (School of Business and Economics), Tilburg University (Department of Economics) and Wageningen University (Development Economics Group), with external funding from the Stichting Universiteitsfonds Limburg (SWOL).
:::

### Programme

::: {.programme}

- **Britta Augsburg** [Free Riding and Public Service Delivery: Experimental Evidence from India]{.talk-title} [Discussant: Mark Treurniet]{.discussant}

- **Maarten Voors** [Recruiting and Incentivizing Community Service Providers in Sierra Leone]{.talk-title} [Discussant: Natascha Wagner]{.discussant}
- **Mushfiq Mobarak** [Seasonal Poverty, Remittance Frictions, and Loans]{.talk-title} [Discussant: Stefan Leeffers]{.discussant}
- **Eleonora Nillesen** [Breaking Down Menstrual Barriers in Bangladesh: Cluster RCT Evidence on School Attendance and Psychosocial Outcomes of Adolescent Girls]{.talk-title} [Discussant: Robert Lensink]{.discussant}
- **Menno Pradhan** [Scores, Camera, Action: Social Accountability and Teacher Incentives in Remote Areas]{.talk-title} [Discussant: Joost de Laat]{.discussant}

#### Friday 22 April

- **Karen Macours** [Texting Parents about Early Child Development: Behavioral Changes and Unintended Social Effects]{.talk-title} [Discussant: Kristina Czura]{.discussant}
- **Anna Baiardi** [Female Admission Caps in Higher Education: The Case of Iran]{.talk-title} [Discussant: Karlijn Morsink]{.discussant}
- **Catherine Guirkinger** [Pro-Birth Policies, Missions and Fertility: Historical Evidence from Congo]{.talk-title} [Discussant: Marina Aguiar Palma]{.discussant}
- **Pieter Serneels** [The Collective Action Mechanism in Community-Based Monitoring of Public Services]{.talk-title} [Discussant: Stephan Dietrich]{.discussant}
